sentences.text: A big lion sleeps in the warm sun.

translations.en: A big lion sleeps in the warm sun.
translations.fr: Un grand lion dort sous le chaud soleil.
translations.es: Un gran león duerme bajo el cálido sol.

sentences.text: A little mouse runs across his nose.

translations.en: A little mouse runs across his nose.
translations.fr: Une petite souris court sur son nez.
translations.es: Un pequeño ratón corre sobre su nariz.

sentences.text: The lion wakes up and catches the mouse.

translations.en: The lion wakes up and catches the mouse.
translations.fr: Le lion se réveille et attrape la souris.
translations.es: El león se despierta y atrapa al ratón.

sentences.text: He opens his mouth to eat her.

translations.en: He opens his mouth to eat her.
translations.fr: Il ouvre la gueule pour la manger.

sentences.text: The little mouse begs for her life.

translations.en: The little mouse begs for her life.
translations.fr: La petite souris supplie pour sa vie.
translations.es: El pequeño ratón suplica por su vida.

sentences.text: She says that she can help him one day.

translations.en: She says that she can help him one day.
translations.fr: Elle dit qu'elle peut l'aider un jour.
translations.es: Dice que puede ayudarlo algún día.

sentences.text: The lion laughs at her funny words.

translations.en: The lion laughs at her funny words.
translations.fr: Le lion rit de ses paroles amusantes.
translations.es: El león se ríe de sus divertidas palabras.

sentences.text: But the kind lion lets her go free.

translations.en: But the kind lion lets her go free.
translations.fr: Mais le gentil lion la laisse partir libre.
translations.es: Pero el amable león lo deja ir libre.

sentences.text: One week later, hunters catch the big lion.

translations.en: One week later, hunters catch the big lion.
translations.fr: Une semaine plus tard, des chasseurs attrapent le grand lion.
translations.es: Una semana después, unos cazadores atrapan al gran león.

sentences.text: They tie him to a tree with heavy ropes.

translations.en: They tie him to a tree with heavy ropes.
translations.fr: Ils l'attachent à un arbre avec de lourdes cordes.
translations.es: Lo atan a un árbol con cuerdas pesadas.

sentences.text: The lion roars loudly in pain.

translations.en: The lion roars loudly in pain.
translations.fr: Le lion rugit fort de douleur.
translations.es: El león ruge fuertemente de dolor.

sentences.text: The little mouse hears his loud roar.

translations.en: The little mouse hears his loud roar.
translations.fr: La petite souris entend son fort rugissement.
translations.es: El pequeño ratón escucha su fuerte rugido.

sentences.text: She runs to the lion and bites the ropes.

translations.en: She runs to the lion and bites the ropes.
translations.fr: Elle court vers le lion et mord les cordes.
translations.es: Corre hacia el león y muerde las cuerdas.

sentences.text: Her sharp teeth cut through the net.

translations.en: Her sharp teeth cut through the net.
translations.fr: Ses dents pointues coupent le filet.
translations.es: Sus dientes afilados cortan la red.

sentences.text: The lion is free once more.

translations.en: The lion is free once more.
translations.fr: Le lion est de nouveau libre.
translations.es: El león está libre otra vez.

sentences.text: Little friends can show great kindness.

translations.en: Little friends can show great kindness.
translations.fr: Les petits amis peuvent faire preuve d'une grande bonté.
translations.es: Los pequeños amigos pueden mostrar una gran bondad.
